results.question: Show revenue by product category for all time, highest first.
results.sql:
SELECT 
  c.name AS category_name,
  SUM(oi.unit_price_cents * oi.quantity) AS revenue
FROM 
  order_items oi
JOIN 
  products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
  categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY 
  c.name
ORDER BY 
  revenue DESC;

results.question: Who are our 5 biggest customers by revenue? Show their names and how much they spent.
results.sql:
SELECT 
  c.full_name AS customer_name,
  SUM(o.total_cents) AS total_spent
FROM 
  customers c
JOIN 
  orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 
  c.id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
  total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

results.question: How many orders has each carrier shipped?
How many orders came from each customer segment?
results.sql:
SELECT c.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment;

results.question: What are the top 3 customer countries by number of orders?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  customers.country, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id) AS order_count
FROM 
  customers
JOIN 
  orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
GROUP BY 
  customers.country
ORDER BY 
  order_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

results.question: What is revenue this month?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM((oi.unit_price_cents * oi.quantity) - (oi.unit_price_cents * oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price_cents - products.price_cents) / products.price_cents)) AS revenue
FROM 
  order_items oi
JOIN 
  products ON oi.product_id = products.id
WHERE 
  oi.order_id IN (
    SELECT 
      id
    FROM 
      orders
    WHERE 
      EXTRACT(MONTH FROM placed_at) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM placed_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  );

results.question: How are sales doing?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS total_orders,
  SUM(o.total_cents) / 100.0 AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_products_sold,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_shipments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_refunds,
  SUM(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 AS total_refunded_amount
FROM 
  orders o
  LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN shipments s ON o.id = s.order_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.id = r.order_id
WHERE 
  o.placed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days';

results.question: What's our best product?
results.sql:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.active = true
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY total_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Show me the big orders from this week.
results.sql:

FROM orders o
WHERE o.placed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY o.total_cents DESC
LIMIT 10;

results.question: What is our website conversion rate this month?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM placed_at) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN orders.id END) AS completed_orders,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN orders.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id), 2) AS conversion_rate
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM placed_at);

results.question: Which marketing campaign brought in the most revenue?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  o.channel AS campaign,
  SUM(oi.unit_price_cents * oi.quantity) AS revenue
FROM 
  orders o
JOIN 
  order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY 
  o.channel
ORDER BY 
  revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
